note: `reach` is the first year an all-ages block lay within reach_miles (walking) of the point; 0 means never. `off` lists the later years it was out of reach again (a dropped Slow Street or a removed bikeway), in which the map greys it; a point is lit in year Y when 0 < reach <= Y and Y is not in `off`. `near` is the key of the block that first reached it, blank for points reached from the 2015 baseline; a key "SS:<cnn>" is a pandemic Slow Street block SFMTA dropped in 2022 (site/data/bike-history/removed.json). `reach_<id>` and `off_<id>` on a block row, and `reach_by` and `off_by` on a school or branch, give the same at each other distance in `thresholds`.
